name: miniOrange Active Directory / LDAP Integration
description: Allows your users to login to your Drupal site using their LDAP / Active Directory credentials.
project_description:
With the LDAP / Active Directory Integration module, your users can easily log in to Drupal using the same credentials they use in Active Directory (AD). Streamline your authentication process with a secure and reliable bridge between Drupal and LDAP. The module works with all major Drupal versions, including Drupal 7, and supports popular LDAP servers like Microsoft Active Directory, OpenLDAP, OpenDS, FreeIPA, and Synology. It ensures data privacy during login and centralizes user management, saving your administrators time and effort. 

 Know more Setup Guide Our unique case-studies 

 Key Features of LDAP / Active Directory Integration: 

 
 NTLM Kerberos Authentication: With this feature, you can auto-login to your Drupal site and authenticate users through Windows with the LDAP integration module. 
 Sync User Data from AD to Drupal: Keep user information up to date with automatic synchronization between Active Directory and your Drupal site. 
 LDAPS Support: The LDAP / Active Directory Integration module fully supports LDAPS, which uses TLS/SSL to provide better security for your Drupal site. 
 Backdoor login: This provides a fallback login method, ensuring access to your Drupal site even if the Active Directory server becomes unreachable. 
 Login Restriction: Allow or block user access on Drupal, Active Directory, or both based on your security needs. 
 Role and Attribute Mapping: Integrate this feature to map user attributes and assign roles from your LDAP server directly to your Drupal site.
 
 Search with Multiple Attributes: Search users using LDAP server attributes such as email, username, display name, and more. 
 Post Login & Logout Redirection: Choose where users should be redirected after login and logout for a smoother user experience.
